notes.title: Journey to the Rift: The Dwarven Halls, releasing 22nd November!
notes.content:
I hope you’ve all been enjoying your adventures in Journey to the Rift! For those of you who want more, I’m happy to announce the release of the first expansion pack for Journey to the Rift: The Dwarven Halls! 

Now don’t worry, for those of you who enjoy the free game, that will still be available to enjoy for free, forever. However, if you want to experience more puzzles, more intrigue, and more adventure, then The Dwarven Halls will deliver.

The Dwarven Halls will introduce a whole new floor to the dungeon, which you can explore instead of the normal second floor in the dungeon. The Dwarven Halls, as the name suggests, were once home to a contingent of dwarves who managed to break away from the dungeon, and made themselves another home underground. However, one of their many experiments yielded unexpected results, so you will have to contend with the curious contraptions of the dwarves, as well as the stout stalwarts themselves!

Look forward to The Dwarven Halls, releasing on the 22nd November for the price of £4.29/$4.99. And for those of you enjoying the free game, stay tuned for an upcoming free update, which will add an endless endurance mode to the dungeon, and a legendary difficulty setting!

notes.title: 25/10/2024 Small bug fixes
notes.content:
Just a few small bug fixes this week! But keep your eyes peeled for upcoming updates, including the release of endless mode and legendary mode, and the release of the first expansion pack, the Dwarven Halls!

- Fixed bug where playing offline would sometimes cause crashes
- Fixed bug with the Jester encounter ending early
- Fixed bug with the vault puzzle getting stuck in certain scenarios

notes.title: Journey to the Rift - Releasing August 30th!
notes.content:
Journey to the Rift is releasing on August 30th, are you ready to explore a dungeon full of danger, daring, and dwarves? Journey to the Rift will be releasing with over one hundred unique encounters, including puzzles, monsters, and traces of lore explaining how this strange dungeon came to be!

Everyone can play Journey to the Rift completely for free. That's right, five floors filled with fun, foes, and friends for free! So get ready, warm up your typing skills, and prepare for the text-based fun to begin on August 30th!
